Name: (CP) tbh creature pet
Author: matchablaze
Description:
[left][size=4][b]THANK YOU FOR 100+ DOWNLOADS!!! <3333[/b][/size]

Bring the [url=https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/tbh-autism-creature]tbh creature[/url]﻿ (also known as the autism creature) right to your farm!
tbh creature belongs to [url=https://twitter.com/acmeiku]@acmeiku[/url]﻿ on Twitter!

[url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/866168867913990204/977758048712007680/pixelyipee.png]﻿[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/866168867913990204/977758436060192768/pixelyipee.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/url]﻿

[b][size=3]Important information:[/size][/b]
- This mod retextures the default orange cat meaning that it will not be able to be chosen with this mod active.
- There is an optional file included in the mod that lets you alter the default cat sound to a high-pitched 'yipee'. However, this replaces the sound for all the other cats meaning that if the sound file is used, all the other cats will also make the 'yipee' noise.

[b][size=3]Requirements:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232]Sound Effect Replacement[/url]﻿ (ONLY IF YOU WANT TO REPLACE THE CAT SOUND)

[b][size=3]Installation:[/size][/b]
- SMAPI should be installed and Content Patcher should be in [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] (if not, see above for download links)
- Extract the downloaded file and put the[b] tbh creature[/b] folder into [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b].
- Run the game [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]using SMAPI

[/url][b][size=3]﻿Installing Sound Effect:[/size]
[/b]- SMAPI should be installed
- Content Patcher and Sound Effect Replacement should be in [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] (if not, see above for download links)
- Put [b]tbh creature sound[/b] folder into [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\
[/b]- Take the audio file in [b]\tbh creature sound\sound[/b] ([i]yipee.wav[/i]) and put it in [b]\SoundEffectReplacement\assets
- Run the game [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]using SMAPI[/url][/b]
